notes.title: WE ARE NOW FREE-TO-PLAY + F2P PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
[h1]WE ARE NOW FREE TO PLAY[/h1]
We are now officially a F2P title. We look forward to this next chapter of our long decade+ journey. We hope this allows more gamers like you to see what we've put into our game, for free and have an easier decision to make to stick around, join our community and help us grow the game more.

We invite/encourage all players to join our Discord at [url=http://discord.gg/playhanako]http://discord.gg/playhanako[/url]

[h1]Patch Notes: F2P Patch - Version 1.2[/h1]
For this patch we wanted to focus on a few important areas: Adding more content to the item store, taking the three largest areas of feedback on the game: 1) dEaD GaMe (why we are going F2P to let anyone play any time); 2) "Needs more Impact"; 3) "Game is clunky in spots".

[h2]New Content[/h2]
- Unicorn & Kintsukuroi Sets - All helmets, hats, masks, hair are equippable on both classes. All items in these sets have a different version for Hanako & Yamai (to help with recognizing which team is which).
[url=https://scontent-atl3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.30808-6/266004118_4652336118165875_4733620695934093777_n.jpg?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-5&_nc_sid=730e14&_nc_ohc=Ofm-E1NqYgAAX-Q4HiS&_nc_oc=AQm4rnyfbYgO-2AyCEDYyedBbiZRDq_a878TjisPH3BgCMbkmqSFduZiWveNIAk2MCc&_nc_ht=scontent-atl3-1.xx&oh=da32da2f06d82a72afa40e5527775c40&oe=61B86859][img]https://scontent-atl3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.30808-6/266004118_4652336118165875_4733620695934093777_n.jpg?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-5&_nc_sid=730e14&_nc_ohc=Ofm-E1NqYgAAX-Q4HiS&_nc_oc=AQm4rnyfbYgO-2AyCEDYyedBbiZRDq_a878TjisPH3BgCMbkmqSFduZiWveNIAk2MCc&_nc_ht=scontent-atl3-1.xx&oh=da32da2f06d82a72afa40e5527775c40&oe=61B86859[/img][/url]
- Unicorn Set: 12 items total: 4 player skins, 4 weapon skins, helmet, hat, hair, mask.

[url=https://scontent-atl3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.30808-6/266057663_4652336114832542_4801860414987035406_n.jpg?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-5&_nc_sid=730e14&_nc_ohc=XXIO_hlFQ-MAX-mI5y6&_nc_ht=scontent-atl3-1.xx&oh=f66bf68221c870d3a125e44c24c1af7c&oe=61B6FBDC][img]https://scontent-atl3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.30808-6/266057663_4652336114832542_4801860414987035406_n.jpg?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-5&_nc_sid=730e14&_nc_ohc=XXIO_hlFQ-MAX-mI5y6&_nc_ht=scontent-atl3-1.xx&oh=f66bf68221c870d3a125e44c24c1af7c&oe=61B6FBDC[/img][/url]
- Kintsukuroi Set (inspired by the "golden-repair" style of Japanese pottery): 11 items total: 4 player skins, 4 weapon skins, helmet, hat, mask.

[h2]New Features[/h2]
- New "ripout" animations for melee hits on the Kenshi and Nagi on basic attacks.
- New "combo counter" FX for hitting enemies with combo abilities.
- New ability hit FX for increasing the impact of hitting enemies with abilities.
- Updates to hit detection to be more responsive.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Major bug fixes/crash fixes for server stability.
- Major bug fix for "hit reactions" causing rubber banding/general clunkiness. We believe this was responsible for most of the game's clunky "feel" at times.
- Major localization fixes for missing text in various menus (custom game and killstreaks).
- Other minor bug fixes in other areas of the game.

[h2]What's Next[/h2]
- Samurai Royale - We will start public testing of our Battle Royale mode (24 players) starting after the holidays in early 2022.
- Challenges/unlocks - Depending on how the playerbase grows, we will begin systems to unlock items based on daily/weeklies and other in-game challenges.
- AI improvements
- New classes and map (for Samurai Royale)

Thank you for all of your support. At this stage, we're about a 4 person team working on this after our jobs and we will do our best to keep the game updated and address issues, but please be patient with us as we manage what comes next. Most bugs can only be fixed by one of our devs and requires investigation. We will always do our best to prioritize and make our game the best it can be.

-Hanako Dev Team

notes.title: Final F2P Patch Test Night - Wednesday December 8th @ 10pm EST
notes.notes:
[h1]F2P Patch Testing - Details[/h1]

This is our last test before the F2P patch ships on Friday. We will be testing all of our current features, bug fixes, etc. to make sure the build is stable for release.

We will be testing on a BETA BRANCH during these events, which require some action in Steam. You can opt-in to our testing branch following the steps below:

Step 1) Right click on Hanako: Honor & Blade in your Steam library and click Properties.
Step 2) Click the Betas section.
Step 3) In the "Enter beta access code to unlock private betas:" enter [b]hanakotestingbranch[/b]
Step 4) Click Check Code
Step 5) In the beta dropdown choose [b]testing_branch[/b]
Step 6) This will now download the beta branch patch.

Join us on http://discord.gg/playhanako around 10pm EST for our first post-launch Defeat the Devs.

[h2]Testing Agenda for Tonight[/h2]
- Fixed some issues with the Tutorial.
- Fixed issues with missing text on custom game screen and killstreaks in any non-English language setting.
- Major updates to the Ability hit system

notes.title: Release Date Announcement, Trailer & TONIGHT'S CELEBRATION EVENT 10pm EST
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=i7brAGuKXyo;full][/previewyoutube]
We'll finally be graduating out of Early Access on Steam into full release September 15th. I started this project 14 years ago to honor my late mother and fast forward to now most of our dev team has lost a parent to cancer as our game as a tribute has grown to honor more than just my mom. 

We've worked on this at night, after game/software jobs, in our free time with no budget for the last 10 contiguous years after this started as a college project.

This trailer was a really emotional one for me, the debut of our final map Yamai Castle. I saved this map for last because it's a symbolic representation of getting to face the cancer that took a parent, cleanse it and defeat it. The transformation in the trailer if my favorite thing we've ever done the entire project, I have a hard time watching it and that's very much on purpose.

Hope you all like the trailer and see promise in the game, we hope to see you on the battlefield anytime between now and during/after release. We run events on Discord weekly

Join us on http://discord.gg/playhanako at 10pm EST OR http://twitch.tv/hanakogame

notes.title: Free Weekend for Early Access v.4 Release
notes.notes:
[h1]Free Weekend Details[/h1]
Early Access v.4 patch will release Thursday April 9th at 1pm EST and Hanako: Honor & Blade will be free to try from the 9th-12th for a Steam Free Weekend. We will be active, holding events, streaming and chatting with new friends on our [url=http://discord.gg/playhanako]Discord[/url]

The official trailer for Early Access v.4 will be revealed in the coming weeks before the event/release. We welcome anyone who wants to preview these changes early to join our Discord and play in one of our Wednesday night events, where we playtest the below changes to get them ready for full release.

[h1]Early Access v.4 Details[/h1]
Our talented team of 8 developers have been hard at work, at-night, after work to make Hanako the best it can be over the last year since our last large patch. We've soft-released a lot of features as we've completed them and couldn't be happier with where we are.

Here are some features/improvements/content to expect in the EA4 patch:
[list]
[*] New Map - Yamai Village (Our 2nd to last campaign map)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/73zMznI.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VG2fQ6v.png[/img]
[*] Item Store (Items will slowly be added time permitting)
[*] Refined combat (Tons of new animations, hit detection and polished combat)
[*] Tons of gamemode refinements and polish
[*] Addition of victory cinematics to each level at match end
[*] Refined audio design for combat, punchier impact sounds
[*] More thematic elements (like seppuku, map changes, and more)
[*] Various polish across all of our maps
[*] Refined gameplay messaging to help make objectives more clear
[*] And many other small, incremental changes to help the game feel more satisfying.
[/list]

We will do ONE more major patch, focused on stability and polish (called Early Access v.5) and then we will be moving out of Early Access into full release, presently targeting Q3-Q4 2020.

notes.title: Patch: Early Access.v3.03 - Major Crash Fix, Combat Improvements
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Kenshi's light stance should now be more fluid and weighted. The animation blends have been adjusted.
[*] The Naginatashi and Kenshi's heavy attacks now allow movement during the "recovery period."
[*] The Naginatashi's light stance right and stab attacks now are WIP prototypes of our new light stance design that includes some built-in "movement/weight plants" for more significant impact.
[*] New hit sounds for YOU hitting someone and YOU being hit that are more obvious.
[*] Seppuku (suicide) and Reconnect are now re-bindable. Seppuku defaults to the 'L' key and Reconnect defaults to 'F5'. This is useful if you get a soft lock/lose input/etc.
[*] Added Seppuku animations to each class. This will eventually improve to allow you to see the entire animation before "dying" to prevent flooding and robbing kills.
[*] Many UX/UI improvements such as objective breadcrumbs, enemy health bar improvements and more.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[*] Major bug fix for crash related to Ite projectiles. This was responsible for almost all crashes the last 2 weeks.
[*] [b]Known Issue: [/b]Temporarily moved spectator after reaching 0 tickets on battle mode. This was to fix a soft lock when changing maps.
[*] Major AI pathing fixes on Yari Foothills map.
[*] Various bug fixes relating to settings not saving/applying.
[*] Fixed item store items from appearing in game after being equipped.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: EAv3.02 & Weekly Defeat the Devs Starting Back Tonight!
notes.notes:

[list]
[*]Fix for bots not dying properly (they were switching teams and running aimlessly on death)
[*]Camera tweaks to try to allow enemies/targets to be more visible/readable
[*]Overhaul of objective HUD section to be more readable and clear what the objective is.
[*]Replaced text on objectives with icons to show what to do more clearly.
[*]Added rolling incense smoke trails to direct players to objectives.
[*]Various AI changes to make bots able to aim up/down (Archer bots) and various code cleanup
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]Sometimes dying will leave a "blank idle player" in the spot you died. We haven't been able to track down the cause/solution just yet.
[*]Sometimes servers can lock up or crash on map change, this is being investigated.
[*]Loading screens can sometimes cause a crash, especially on slower machines.
[/list]

[b]Defeat the Devs Details for Tonight[/b]
Tonight at 10pm EST on http://discord.gg/playhanako we'll be resuming our Defeat the Devs events. This is a chance for players to meet the dev team, hangout on voice chat and play against a server of players. 

We will give a free key to the game to participants to bring a friend next time for playing in a few rounds of our event and joining the Discord. We hope to see you there.

[b]Other Notes[/b]
After a publishing review and survey we have re-written a lot of the roadmap for the development path for the game. We will be focusing exclusively on the Battle and Siege (Objective-based) game modes and iterating rapidly on different ideas and try to make a mode with more dynamics and strategy while focusing on bringing more of the Feudal Japanese theme to life and polishing our core gameplay to feel and read better.

notes.title: Patch Release & Notes: Early Access v.3.01
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch EAv.3.01 Live Now![/h1]
Our first hotfix/small update since Early Access 3 released back in April is now live! We will be soft-launching a lot of smaller improvements to animations and other gameplay polish a little bit at a time as we work towards larger features in Early Access v.4.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[b]Improvements/Polish[/b]
[list]
[*] Re-worked Queues to max out at 2 minutes, afterwords it will find the lowest ping server available. This is an effort to minimize wasted waits while our game is growing.
[*] Added 30fps and 60fps Vsync options.
[*] Adjustments to sprint/zoom cameras to show more of the character and be less jarring.
[*] Slight attack speed changes to make attacks more fluid.
[*] Animation Polish: New block for the Kenshi, experimental prototype for running->sprinting; new animations for landing while moving forward/sprinting on land.
[*] Polish of movement animation logic to make directional movement much smoother for all classes. 
[*] Holding block now has a movement penalty.
[*] Ite bots are now part of the AI fillers on servers.
[*] New ambiences in all maps for better audio experience.
[/list]

[b]Bug/Exploit Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a major server-side crash relating to skill trees that's blocked overall patching.
[*] Fixed an exploit relating to Skill trees allowing stacking of stats.
[*] Fixed exploit allowing VIPs on Assassination mode to spawn camp and stay invulnerable, making matches always go down to tie breaker/never ending.
[*] Fixed sound sliders not saving, forcing themselves to 0 and/or not working at all.
[*] Fixed Kage VIP class being scaled, which was causing tons of weapon separation in animations.
[*] Temporary fix in tutorial map where players could open the ESC menu during the skill tree sequence, closing the skill tree and breaking the tutorial flow.
[*] Fix for various audio issues pertaining to sounds playing globally.
[*] Fixed exploit/bug allowing long chat messages that could crash servers.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access 3 Patch Details & Dev Update
notes.notes:
[b]Early Access 3 - Coming in Feb/March[/b]

[url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/hanako-soul-of-the-samurai/news/early-access-3-details-dev-update]READ THE FULL UPDATE[/url]

We've been working since October on our Early Access 3 patch and it is our largest release so far. We think this really brings us close to the goal line of 1.0 Full Release.

[b]Feature Highlights[/b]

[list]
[*] Matchmaking, leaderboards/stats/achievements, new menus, parties/social
[*] New tutorial teaching new mechanics, features and more classes.
Per-match skill trees/leveling
[*] Co-op vs. AI mode (wave-based, play with 1-4 players)
[*] New heavy stance attacks for Kenshi/Naginatashi
[*] Tons of bug fixes and improvements
[*] In-match Rivals & Duel challenging
[*] Testing/Events
[/list]

We offer public testing of the game and bits and pieces of these features every week on Wednesdays at 10PM EST on our Discord: [url=http://discord.gg/playhanako]Discord.gg[/url] - This will help us get everything ready for the big time!

[b]New Gameplay Changes[/b]

As mentioned above we are bringing three new huge gameplay options, the last of our core gameplay from our original design. Per-match skill trees will allow players to chose between Abilities (think Moba actives), Talents (dodges, double-tap moves) and stat boosts (health, armor, better accuracy, etc.) all to work towards unlocking a powerful MASTER ABILITY.


We're also re-working the Swordsman and Pikeman's heavy stance attacks to no longer be root-motion forced dash attacks that are clunky and hard to aim. We'll allow full range of motion until the attack plants allowing for a more fluid experience:

[b]Release Date[/b]
We don't have a concrete release, but we'll be releasing a trailer later in January and hope the patch will be ready by late February/early March at latest.

[b]Important Links[/b]

[url=http://discord.gg/playhanako]Official Discord[/url]

[url=http://roadmap.playhanako.com]Development Roadmap[/url]

Happy 2019 Hanako Family, from the Hanako Dev Team!

notes.title: Halloween Patch + Play w/ Devs Tonight at 10PM EST
notes.notes:
[h1]Halloween Patch![/h1]
[list]
[*]Matchmaking - Our new logic-based matchmaking has been rolled out. It has some testing and additional refinements required, but it is WAY better than what we've had previously which failed to get a match 99% of the time.
[*]Lots of bug fixes - Fixed the networking/rootmotion/animation glitchiness that's plagued live for the last few months. Combat should be much smoother
[*]WIP new heavy attacks and dodge abilities for some classes - they will continue to be updated as we test/refine gameplay. They allow free movement on the Naginatashi
[*]Skilltrees - This is the last of our large core mechanic. Players get 4 skill points to purchase abilities with across a match. The talent section (Yellow section) that contains movement skills/dodges is a work in progress, those animations are still WIP or non-existent at this time.
[*]Lots of new UI - New main menu, new server browser and host game screens completely overhauled to look way better.
[*]Achievements & Leaderboards & Stats (oh my) - We have a new Player Stats section that lets you view career stats, per game averages for your Steam Account and leaderboards of key stats like Kils, Wins, Avg. DPS per match. We added 13 test achievements and will be adding more over the coming months.
[/list]
These are core features of our EA3 patch, but we wanted to roll out early iterations so we can get feedback and we felt they were better than what we had previous.

[h1]Event Tonight (10/31)[/h1]
The dev team will be playing on US-East Official server at 10PM EST tonight for a few hours, testing out the new features, playing through some campaigns and having fun with the playerbase. Hope to see you there!

-Matt

notes.title: Early Access 2 Patch Notes & Known Issues
notes.notes: [h1][u]Early Access 2 (0.2.000.0) Official Patch Notes[/u][/h1][h1][u]New Content[/u][/h1][list][*][u]New Map: Shiga Forest (Capture the Scroll)[/u][list][*][u]New Capture the Scroll map that introduces the Yamai territory to the game.[/u][/*][*][u]First new map to feature more path-driven, corridor-like gameplay. (Don’t forget secret Ninja tree paths)[/u][/*][/list][/*][*][u]The Ite (Samurai Archer) introduced to the game.[/u][list][*][u]First ranged character.[/u][/*][*][u]Features a 3 ability kit with an AOE DOT, Cone shot and Impale + Hard CC Master Ability.[/u][/*][*][u]High mobility, low armor[/u][/*][/list][/*][*][u]New UI[/u][list][*][u]The main and play menus have been re-worked completely.[/u][list][*][u]We wanted a more modern look and feel to start working towards future console releases.[/u][/*][/list][/*][*][u]Updated scoreboard[/u][list][*][u]Added assists as a trackable stat to the scoreboard and Top Players screen.[/u][/*][*][u]Added class headshot icons to scoreboard to see what classes other players are.[/u][/*][*][u]Changed highlights, styling and sorting to show YOU as the first player and sort by most kills.[/u][/*][*][u]New audio treatments[/u][/*][/list][/*][*][u]Various foley and sound FX have been reworked or replace years old temporary audio cues.[/u][/*][/list][/*][/list][h1][u]Bug Fixes, Gameplay Improvements, Miscellaneous[/u][/h1][list][*][u]Fixes for various crashes, especially relating to the Ite, uncovered during open testing.[/u][/*][*][u]Upgrade to Unreal Engine 4.19[/u][list][*][u]This offers us tools for better optimization, cleaner networking and other visual treatments we’ve been waiting on.[/u][/*][*][u]Removal of the cel outline effect from foliage.[/u][/*][/list][/*][*][u]Gameplay messaging improvements to make it more obvious what to do in Capture the Scroll matches.[/u][/*][*][u]Fixed bots not switching colors correctly when they’d switch teams for auto-balance some portion of the time.[/u][/*][*][u]Added/fixed Invert Y-Axis option in settings.[/u][/*][*][u]Potential fix for Mouse/camera not working on some EU keyboards/mouse combos. [/u][/*][*][u]Potential fix for sound sliders not working.[/u][/*][*][u]Added invulnerability timer of 3 seconds to spawning to cut back on spawn camping, especially during Base Capture type modes.[/u][/*][*][u]Added heartbeat effect and flashing Health and/or Ki flowers when you’re low on either resource.[/u][/*][*][u]Added victory animations for all classes during the Top Players screen at the end of matches.[/u][/*][*][u]New emotes for every character.[/u][/*][*][u]Prototype for decapitation (happens on each kill shot presently).[/u][/*][*][u]Added administration options to dedicated servers. (Still a bit WIP)[/u][list][*][u]Add -ADMINPASSWORD=password to your server startup shortcut.[/u][/*][*][u]Use /admin password [/u][i][u]password[/u][/i][u] to login[/u][/*][*][u]Use /admin htravel [/u][i][u]mapname[/u][/i][u] to change maps. Valid maps:[/u][list][*][u]GifuCrossroads[/u][/*][*][u]YariFoothills[/u][/*][*][u]HanakoVillage[/u][/*][*][u]HanakoCastle[/u][/*][*][u]HanakoDojo[/u][/*][*][u]NightStreets[/u][/*][*][u]YariDuel[/u][/*][*][u]ShigaForest[/u][/*][/list][/*][*][u]Additional Commands[/u][list][*][u]/admin hkillallbots[/u][/*][*][u]/admin haddbot # (You cannot remove them yet so use this carefully)[/u][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h1][u]Known Issues[/u][/h1][list][*][u]Settings/UI Issues[/u][list][*][u]Keybinds may not be working properly, this will be addressed in a future hotfix. (Changing engine versions broke a lot of UI)[/u][/*][*][u]Sound sliders may reset between matches or restarts.[/u][/*][*][u]Server browser Refresh may not always be reliable, you may need to restart game if servers don’t show OR click Quick Play to get into a game if servers don’t show.[/u][/*][*][u]In-game settings menu back button sometimes takes multiple clicks.[/u][/*][*][u]Some EU keyboard/mouse combos cause the mouse to not work, if this happens LET US KNOW we’ve been trying to fix it for a while.[/u][/*][*][u]The 3v3 and Duel buttons may match you to a normal game. You can access 3v3 and Duel servers from the Server Browser or from Host Custom Game.[/u][/*][/list][/*][*][u]Gameplay Issues[/u][list][*][u]Bots may sometimes be the wrong texture color, but the red enemy outline/nameplate colors will be correct.[/u][/*][*][u]Projectiles (abilities that shoot darts, arrows, etc.) have a small percent chance of not displaying/firing. We are working to fix this ASAP.[/u][/*][*][u]If you direct hit a player with the Ite Master Ability, the effects may not play, but it will still deal damage.[/u][/*][*][u]There are some animation bugs with bots when you knockback/knockback/stun sometimes.[/u][/*][*][u]Minimap needs re-work to be added back to the HUD.[/u][/*][*][u]AI at times get stuck on objects, pathing will be overhauled in a future release.[/u][/*][*][u]The Ninja weapon sometimes separates from the hand, that will be fixed in a future release.[/u][/*][/list][/*][*][u]Hosting (Listen) Games[/u][list][*][u]Sometimes when changing maps it will keep the game mode from the previous map.[/u][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Early Access 2 Coming + Dev Update
notes.notes:
Dev Update Week 4 May, 2018

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pJj2Emq63CE

Since our initial soft release to Early Access in October 2017, we’ve been working tirelessly to release our fourth and final full release character class, the Ite (Samurai Archer). He introduces ranged combat to Hanako for the first time and features an ability kit offering crowd control, dealing with cornering and more.

Side News: We are now approved Xbox One and PS4 Developers. Hanako: Honor & Blade will be coming to consoles at a later date TBD.

We’ve also created a new map called Shiga Forest. The first in the dark, death-ridden territory of our game’s antagonist clan, the Yamai. The main menu has been overhauled in an early version of our panel-based presentation to start modernizing our game for the future!

This patch will release on June 14th, 2018 at Midnight EST. We'll start a live stream event around 11PM on Wednesday June 13th on twitch.tv/hanakogame

We're considering this our "hard launch" to Early Access since it includes the Archer character that we intended to release initially when we went live to Early Access.

As always we are available in the following places:

Official Site: http://www.Playhanako.com
Discord: http://Discord.gg/PlayHanako

Much Love,

Hanako Dev Team

notes.title: Patch 0.1.290.0 Notes - New Menu System, Updated Scoreboard, Updated New Map (Alpha), Archer Balance
notes.notes:
New Features
 - We reworked all of our main menus and game lobby to have a more modern, panel-based paradigm. We hope this will make it easier to get to the right place.
 - We added class icons to the scoreboard so you can tell who is what class.
 - Shiga Forest map has had updates as we get closer to Content Lock for our big release.
 
Balance Changes
 - Ite had his DPS reduced on both stances since they were about 3x all other classes.
 - Ite had his Jump height reduced slightly.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.300.0
notes.notes:
New Features
  - NEW Map (Alpha Version): Shiga Forest - Capture the Scroll map. This map is our first Yamai Territory Campaign map. It's available on the US East server.

Changes
  - Fixed a variety of bugs with scroll capture feedback in levels (still has a few lingering issues).
  - Extended Assist calculations to make it easier to log Assists.
  - Some back-end work for stat gathering.
  - Level smoothing on some terrain snags in Yari Foothills.
  - Removed new Hit Reaction tech to fix GIANT FREAKING HEADS.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.275.0 Notes - New Scoreboard Improvements, Level Bug Fixes, Assists and Team XP Prototypes
notes.notes:
[b]New Improvements[/b]
- Scoreboard has been improved for readability.
- Scoreboard now sorts by placing the local player (YOU) at the top and sorting all other players/bots by highest Kills.
- Scoreboard has Team XP (to be used later for in-game leveling/acquiring skill points for skill trees).
- Scoreboard now has Assists listed (Assist calculations still WIP but may work sometimes).
- Added Most Assists to the Accolades screen at the end of matches.
- Added Assists to the HUD with your Kill | Death stats in the Top Right.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed a hole in the landscape in Yari Foothills that you'd get stuck or fall through the world.
- Fixed some jagged terrain that you'd have to jump over.
- Fixed some grey box meshes that made it into a release build.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.220.0 Notes - Decapitation, Server Admin, New Duel Map, RP Mode, CTI Improvements & More
notes.notes:
[b]Gameplay Improvements/New Features[/b]
- All player characters can be decapitated if they're hit near the head on the kill shot.
- Prototype for RP Mode added with support for all existing maps.
- NEW MAP- Hanako Dojo (good for 1v1 to 3v3)
- Improvements to the game play in Yari Foothills (CTI)
- Added messaging to show you where to take the scroll.

[b]Fixes/Changes[/b]
- Fixed scrolls to have a reset timer if they get dropped or fall off a cliff.
- Changed bot difficulty curve to have bots that use abilities and both teams will have stronger bots evenly.

[b]Admin System[/b]
- Listen Server games you'll already be the admin and can issue admin commands.
- Dedicated server hosts can add "-ADMINPASSWORD=password" to their startup script. The following commands are supported:

(Press Y to open up chat to type commands)
/admin login password - login
/admin htravel mapname - change map

Available Maps:
GifuCrossroads
YariFoothills
HanakoVillage
HanakoCastle
HanakoDojo
YariDuel
StreetsDuel

/admin haddbot # - adds bots
/admin hforcematchend - force match to end
/admin hkillallbots - kill all bots

We'll be adding more commands over time to make this system better.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.190.0 - "Hit Detection Improvements, Grapple Improvements & More"
notes.notes:
Changes/Fixes
 - Hit detection has been reworked to be more accurate between client/servers.
 - Physics for collision/hit detection has been revised to use PhysX and APEX so we can simplify physics at a distance (Something that made bots perform realy badly.
 - Optimizations for bots/lots of characters. Game should run more smoothly with bots.
 - Various changes to Kusarigama/Grappling code. Grapple should be much better/more responsive and not toss you across the map (sometimes).

Gameplay
 - Scroll carriers in CTS can no longer sprint.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.170.0 - "Auto-Fill, Top Bugs Exterminated, Infinite Block Gone"
notes.notes:
Patch Notes for 0.1.170.0 - "Auto-Fill, Top Bugs Exterminated, Infinite Block Gone" 

We'll also be playing with players (most if not all of the dev team) Wednesday at 10PM EST (we'll do this every Weds). Make sure you're on our Discord: 

http://discord.playhanako.com

Patch 0.1.170.0 is now live! Please make sure your game updates, if not, restart your Steam client.

New Features
-Bot Autofill! 
-Our official servers will now have AI taking place of players until they connect so servers are never empty.
-You can now Check 'Bots Fill' in Host Game and your server will have bots that hold spots until players connect.
-If you're hosting you can also type '/haddbot 12' in chat to get 12 bots. -Adding this way may not obey Auto-fill Rules
-Hosted games can check Unlimited Ki
-All players can have unlimited Ki for all things during these matches. This is our first feature to give players "mutators/novelty options" outside of official rules.

Bug Fixes
-"Input lock" related to blocking where players would get stuck/rubber  band in place after block/parry has been fixed. 
-Certain abilities could double hit at point-blank range or not do damage at all at far range. This has been fixed.
-AI pathing issues have been partially resolved in Hanako Castle
-AI pathing adjustments in all maps
-Known Issue: Pathing in general needs polish/work and is planned for a future patch when we introduce more complex AI behaviors.
-Fix for resolutions not properly setting sometimes.

Balance Changes
-Ninja grapple miss cooldown increased to 1.5s from 1.0s
-Naginatashi block Ki cost increased from 25% dmg to 50% dmg.
-Kenshi block Ki cost increased from 50% dmg to 75% dmg.
-Ninja medium stance "can attack again" time increased from 0.75s to 0.85s to fix an animation glitch and adjust left-right/right-left kite spam.
